description: Install maplibre-gl and register a MapTiler API key via environment variable
steps: Run: npm install maplibre-gl

Create a free MapTiler account at maptiler.com and generate an API key — REQUIRED: add domain restrictions in the MapTiler dashboard (add your production domain AND localhost) before using the key anywhere; an unrestricted key baked into a NEXT_PUBLIC_ env var is freely usable by anyone who reads the JS bundle
Add NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTILER_KEY=<your_key> to .env.local
Add NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTILER_KEY=YOUR_MAPTILER_KEY_HERE to .env.example as a placeholder
Verify process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTILER_KEY is non-empty inside the map component before proceeding to the next item

description: Replace Leaflet map initialisation with MapLibre GL JS pointed at MapTiler Streets v2 style URL
steps: SSR CHECK FIRST: find where near-me-map.tsx is imported and confirm it uses `dynamic(() => import('./near-me-map'), { ssr: false })` — MapLibre accesses window/document and will crash next build if rendered server-side; add the dynamic import if missing
In near-me-map.tsx, replace `import L from 'leaflet'` and `import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css'` with `import maplibregl from 'maplibre-gl'` and `import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css'`

Replace the L.map() init block with: const map = new maplibregl.Map({ container: containerRef.current, style: `https://api.maptiler.com/maps/streets-v2/style.json?key=${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTILER_KEY}`, center: [144.963, -37.813], zoom: 13, attributionControl: true })
IMPORTANT: MapLibre uses [lng, lat] ordering everywhere — all coordinate pairs must be swapped from the Leaflet [lat, lng] pattern
Remove the L.tileLayer(...).addTo(map) call entirely — the style URL already encodes the tile source and visual style
Replace L.control.zoom({ position: 'topright' }).addTo(map) with map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), 'top-right')
Change mapRef type from L.Map | null to maplibregl.Map | null
Change originalCenterRef type from L.LatLng | null to { lat: number; lng: number } | null — MapLibre's getCenter() returns a plain object, not a LatLng with distanceTo()
In the useEffect cleanup (return function), call map.remove() to destroy the MapLibre instance on unmount — omitting this leaks WebGL contexts and event listeners
Verify the map renders green parks, labeled streets, building footprints, and blue water at zoom 13 over Melbourne

description: Port numbered pin icons from Leaflet DivIcon to MapLibre Marker using a custom DOM element
steps: Add import: `import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server'` — required for makePinIcon() and the state-update effect in item 4
Change makePinIcon() to return an HTMLElement instead of L.DivIcon: create a wrapper via document.createElement('div'), set innerHTML = renderToStaticMarkup(<PinMarkup ... />), and return the element
Change markerMapRef type from Map<string, { marker: L.Marker; index: number }> to Map<string, { marker: maplibregl.Marker; el: HTMLElement; index: number }>

In the places useEffect, for each place: const el = makePinIcon(i, active, hovered, color, i * 40); const marker = new maplibregl.Marker({ element: el, anchor: 'bottom' }).setLngLat([place.lng, place.lat]).addTo(map)
Confirm coordinate order: setLngLat([place.lng, place.lat]) — longitude first, latitude second

Attach click and hover listeners on the DOM element: el.addEventListener('click', () => onSelectPlace(place.id)); el.addEventListener('mouseover', () => onHoverPlace(place.id)); el.addEventListener('mouseout', () => onHoverPlace(null))
Store { marker, el, index } in markerMapRef.current.set(place.id, { marker, el, index })
To clear markers between result sets, call marker.remove() for each entry before clearing markerMapRef
Verify numbered pins appear at correct coordinates and the stagger drop animation plays on initial result load

description: Port active/hovered pin state updates to direct DOM mutation on the marker element, avoiding animation replay
steps: In the selectedPlaceId/hoveredPlaceId useEffect, replace marker.setIcon() (Leaflet API, does not exist in MapLibre) with direct DOM mutation: el.innerHTML = renderToStaticMarkup(<PinMarkup index={index} active={active} hovered={hovered} color={color} animDelay={false} />)
Manage z-order via el.style.zIndex: active → '1000', hovered → '500', default → '0'
Verify switching the selected list row enlarges the pin and dims others without replaying the drop animation

description: Port popup card from Leaflet bindPopup to a MapLibre Popup set on each marker with updated CSS selectors
steps: Replace marker.bindPopup(html, options) with: const popup = new maplibregl.Popup({ closeButton: true, maxWidth: '300px', className: 'near-me-popup' }).setHTML(makePopupContent(place, i, color)); marker.setPopup(popup)
The makePopupContent() function and its HTML output are unchanged — maplibregl.Popup.setHTML() accepts the same string
Update the injected CSS in nm-map-styles: replace .near-me-popup .leaflet-popup-content-wrapper with .near-me-popup .maplibregl-popup-content
Replace .near-me-popup .leaflet-popup-content { margin: 0 } with .near-me-popup .maplibregl-popup-content { padding: 0 }
Replace .near-me-popup .leaflet-popup-tip-container { display: none } with .near-me-popup .maplibregl-popup-tip { display: none }
Verify popup opens on marker click showing thumbnail, rating, open status, Directions and Call buttons
Verify popup closes when clicking another marker or the map background

description: Port fit-bounds on new results using maplibregl.LngLatBounds with [lng, lat] coordinate order
steps: Replace the L.latLngBounds() block with: const bounds = new maplibregl.LngLatBounds(); places.forEach(p => bounds.extend([p.lng, p.lat]))
Reset originalCenterRef.current = null and setShowSearchArea(false) before calling fitBounds, same as before

ORDERING CRITICAL — attach the moveend listener BEFORE fitBounds or the event may fire before the listener is registered: `map.once('moveend', () => { originalCenterRef.current = map.getCenter() }); map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: 40, maxZoom: 15 })` — note padding is now a single number (uniform), not [40, 40]
Verify the map reframes to show all result pins with visible padding on both desktop and mobile viewports

description: Port selected-place pan from Leaflet map.panTo to MapLibre map.flyTo with [lng, lat] coordinate order
steps: Replace map.panTo([place.lat, place.lng], { animate: true, duration: 0.4 }) with map.flyTo({ center: [place.lng, place.lat], speed: 1.2 })
Confirm coordinate order: center takes [lng, lat]
Verify clicking a list row smoothly animates the map to centre on the matching pin

description: Port Search this area button using MapLibre map.on('moveend') and haversineKm distance check
steps: Keep map.on('moveend', ...) — MapLibre uses the same event name
Replace map.getCenter().distanceTo(originalCenterRef.current) with: const c = map.getCenter(); haversineKm(c.lat, c.lng, originalCenterRef.current.lat, originalCenterRef.current.lng) * 1000 > 800
haversineKm is already imported from lib/near-me.ts and returns kilometres — multiply by 1000 to get metres
In handleSearchAreaClick, replace map.getCenter() usage: const { lat, lng } = map.getCenter(); pass { lat, lng } to onSearchArea
Verify panning more than ~800 m shows the Search this area pill and clicking it fires onSearchArea with correct lat/lng

description: Port GPS user location dot to MapLibre Marker with a custom pulsing DOM element
steps: Replace the L.marker GPS dot with: const el = document.createElement('div'); el.innerHTML = the existing pulsing ring + blue dot HTML string from the Leaflet divIcon
Create the marker: const dot = new maplibregl.Marker({ element: el, anchor: 'center' }).setLngLat([userLng, userLat]).addTo(map)
Confirm coordinate order: setLngLat([userLng, userLat]) — longitude first
Store in userDotRef.current; call dot.remove() at the top of the effect and on cleanup, same as the Leaflet pattern
The nmGpsPulse CSS animation in nm-map-styles is unchanged — verify the pulsing blue dot renders correctly at the user's GPS position

description: Remove leaflet and react-leaflet from package.json after MapLibre migration is verified end-to-end
steps: Run: npm uninstall leaflet react-leaflet @types/leaflet
Search the codebase for any remaining `from 'leaflet'`, `from 'react-leaflet'`, or `leaflet/dist/leaflet.css` imports and remove them
Run npm run build and confirm zero TypeScript errors and no missing-module warnings
Smoke-test the near-me map in the browser: results load, markers appear, popup opens, hover bridge works, GPS dot shows, Search this area button appears on pan
